diagnostic_modes.stability: mode names remain accepted throughout v1.x; human-readable output is not a machine contract

option_rules.invalid_context: rejected with a CLI usage error instead of being ignored

human.stdout: results or requested human-readable inspection output
human.stderr: CLI, source, compilation, or runtime diagnostics

exit_codes.1: source, compilation, execution, or requested diagnostic failure

json-v1.stdout: one mparser.result 1.x JSON document followed by one LF byte

utility_commands.--help: stable command name; human text layout is not frozen
utility_commands.--version: stable command name and MParser <semver> line shape

removed_before_v1.name: --run-interpreter
removed_before_v1.reason: undocumented pre-v1 alias removed before the v1 contract freeze

compatibility.production: existing v1 production mode and option meanings are not removed or reinterpreted before v2
compatibility.diagnostic: diagnostic mode names remain available in v1.x, but their human text may gain fields or formatting changes
compatibility.machine: machine behavior is governed by mparser.result protocol 1.x, not human CLI formatting
